description: facebookAdLibrary: Search. GET /v1/facebook/adLibrary/search/ads. Search the Meta Ad Library by keyword, with the Ad Library's own filters: country, language, status, media type, ad type, exact phrase, sort, and an impressions date range. Returns searchResults (one card per creative group, as the Ad Library shows them: ad_archive_id, page_name, is_active, publisher_platform, collation_count, start/end dates and a snapshot with body text, images, videos, cards and cta_text), searchR Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

ad_type.description: Search for all ads or only political and issue ads

country.description: Where Facebook showed the ad: one two-letter country code, such as US, or ALL (default). Results can include advertisers from other countries whose ads reached it.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous page. Send it with the same filters.

end_date.description: Only ads with impressions on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Only ads in this language: a two-letter code such as EN, ES or FR.

media_type.description: Ad media type. Defaults to ALL. MEME means an image with text.

query.description: Keyword to search for (up to 200 characters)

search_type.description: keyword_unordered (default) matches the words in any order; keyword_exact_phrase matches the phrase as written.

sort_by.description: Sort by impressions (high to low), or Most Recent (relevancy_monthly_grouped). Defaults to impressions.

start_date.description: Only ads with impressions on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Status of the ad. Defaults to ACTIVE.

trim.description: Set true for a trimmed response.

name: facebook_adLibrary_search_ads
